# Draft Patch Notes — v1.2.4-beta.3

Previous release: v1.2.3

### Features
- keep release feeds from going back in version
- label the update channel selector Releases
- define the beta track as any non-stable release
- make the off-feed prerelease docs label-agnostic
- document off-feed prereleases in the release process
- add an off-feed option for one-off prereleases
- tune the Channel selector's styling
- tune the Channel selector's alignment and size
- size the Channel selector to fit the version line
- keep About's update display across Help tab switches
- reset About's update state on open and keep the version line on one line
- put the Channel selector in About's version line
- clear a found beta on Linux when switching to Stable
- discard a waiting beta update when switching to Stable
- stop checking for updates when the update track changes
- install macOS updates on restart like Windows
- register the beta upgrade track as FEAT-058
- show only actionable update states when About opens
- document one release sequence for stable and beta and retire the beta-release skill
- add a Stable/Beta update track selector and share one update flow
- publish beta builds through the release workflow to a beta update feed
- check the chosen update track and save release notes from the update feed
- Send frontend log entries immediately until first render so launch lines land in order
- Stamp frontend log entries with their own capture time and send the bundle-started milestone immediately
- Capture frontend errors and launch milestones in the webview and forward them to the session log
- Log frontend entries and launch diagnostics to the session log from Rust

### Fixes
- let rows under a non-scrolling ScrollArea's scrollbar strip take the mouse
- use the lighter menu highlight in every menu
- render theme colors as RGB channels
